# Test fixtures

`pdfs/bock2005.pdf` (Bock 2005, Exp Brain Res), `pdfs/heuer2008.pdf` (Heuer & Hegele 2008, Psychol Aging)
and `pdfs/cressman2010.pdf` (Cressman et al. 2010, Neurobiol Aging — the paper that supplies two of the three
autonomously pooled cells, kept so the crop-geometry regression can be proved rather than asserted)
are **copyrighted publisher PDFs** kept here only for local development and validation of the extraction
pipeline. They must be removed or replaced with openly licensed equivalents before this repository is
published or distributed.
